observations: Photo 0: single shredder unit close-up, oval badge reads 'Rexel', body text reads '100X' and 'AUTO+' near the base.
Photo 0 and 1: exterior panels show scuffs, scratches, dust buildup, and worn paint, consistent with heavy office use.
Photo 1: two more units side by side, both marked '100X', one has a torn/taped label area near the oval badge.
Photo 2: five similar units lined up together, all appearing to be the same Rexel 100X Auto+ model, loose power cords visible on at least one unit.
No photos show the shredder plugged in, powered on, the shred bin/bucket, the cutting head/blades, or paper actually being shredded.
No photo shows a rating plate or serial number for cross-check, only the molded/printed model text on the housing.

read_from: photo 0 (oval badge and '100X'/'AUTO+' text on housing)

claims.claim: Fairly Used Rexel Auto+ 100X Paper Shredder
claims.evidence: Brand and model text are visible in photo 0 and 1, but 'fairly used' implies working condition which is not demonstrated in any photo; heavy surface wear is visible instead.

claims.claim: Upgrade your office efficiency with this reliable Rexel...
claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the unit running, shredding paper, or powering on; 'reliable' is a marketing claim not shown.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or motor may be dead (very common in used shredder lots).
risks.proof: Short video clip of the shredder plugged in, switched on, and actively shredding a sheet of paper.

risks.risk: Cutting blades/head may be jammed, dull, or missing teeth, which is not visible from outside photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of the open feed slot/cutting head area.

risks.risk: Shred waste bin/bucket may be missing, cracked, or not included (not visible in any photo).
risks.proof: Photo of the shredder with the bin pulled out or opened showing the bin intact.

risks.risk: Multiple nearly identical units are shown (at least 5-6 in photo 2), but the ad describes a single item; buyer may not know which exact unit, or if this is a bulk/job-lot listing, ships.
risks.proof: Seller confirms in writing (or a photo with a marker/tag) exactly which single unit corresponds to this listing, or confirms it is a multi-unit lot and states quantity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as single unit, worst-case condition, since quantity is unconfirmed

risks.risk: Power cord/plug condition and safety (fraying, exposed wire) not clearly visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the power cord and plug end.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cord condition unknown/needs replacement

proof_requests: Video of the specific unit being sold, powered on and shredding a sheet of paper.
Photo confirming whether this listing is for one unit or multiple units, with quantity stated.
Photo of the open bin/waste compartment showing it is present and intact.
Close-up photo of the cutting head/feed slot and the power cord/plug.
response.reason: Brand and model (Rexel Auto+ 100X) are legible in the photos, so the item is identifiable, but no photo demonstrates power-on or shredding function and bin/cutting-head condition is unseen, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working unit pending the listed proof.
